# Wharf 0.11.0 changes

- Added deterministic `Wharf.Scheduler` contracts and lifecycle states.
- Added work-conserving admission bounded by concurrency and maximum trial
  limits.
- Added successful logical-attempt banking and duplicate skipping.
- Added lifecycle event sink integration and pending cancellation handling.
- Added deterministic scheduler, failure, banking, limit, concurrency, and
  cancellation tests.
